current_detail: H1-R2.37 is the complete physical-layout acceptance candidate without starting KiCad. The onboard analog-video experiment and owner-soldered receiver bay are removed. The exact dual-RP GPIO0..47 electrical baseline remains the reviewed H1-R2.31 pin-map artifact. The exact EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 + ER-TPC035-6 option 5344, its 50-contact i8080-8 adapter, exact C3169104 connector, all 18 U219 bodies, NFC loop and external antenna swept volume are registered. The physical register also contains all eight TX detectors, all five required couplers and eight bounded local evidence islands; the six AD8314 positions use the accepted AD8314ARMZ-REEL / C652687 route and all five board U.FL mates use the exact stocked Hirose U.FL-R-SMT-1(80) / C88374 packaging route. The 208 base-BOM groups are ranked: the current electronics floor is USD 273.42, accepted exact/package-route savings total USD 10.4192, and every current top-20 group has a dated mass-market audit. Four-face, external, internal, antenna-edge and sandwich projections are generated from one coordinate model: 226 registered bodies, zero same-face collisions and 2.59 mm minimum opposing-face clearance against the 0.70 mm rule. H1 has no remaining physical blocker; only explicit user acceptance remains before the H1 status may become reviewed. Live FSUSB42MUX/C11355 routing, the service-VBUS detector/latch and the Pack/Safety powered-off-Ioff boundary are the three fail-closed preconditions for a future R2 H2 export. Purchasing, KiCad and fabrication remain unauthorized.

preorder_release.factory_role: deterministic fabrication, population, display mating and final assembly from released files

stages.exit: placement, routed parity, routed electrical/RF/mechanical re-analysis, production outputs and independent DFM/CPL review
